name: 4-fluorotryptamine
summary: 4-Fluorotryptamine (4-FT; developmental code name PAL-551) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. It is the 4-fluoro derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluorotryptamine (4-FT; developmental code name PAL-551) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. The drug acts as a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 28 nM and an Emax of 108%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin–dopamine releasing agent

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors and monoamine release. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體與單胺釋放的實驗室研究。它不是藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体与单胺释放的实验室研究。它不是药品。

fact.en: Tryptamine is the simple backbone shared by serotonin, melatonin, DMT and psilocin. 4-Fluorotryptamine adds just one fluorine atom to that backbone, yet in lab tests it fully switches on the 5-HT2A receptor that psychedelics act on.
fact.zh: 色胺是血清素、褪黑激素、DMT與脫磷酸裸蓋菇素共同的簡單骨架。4-氟色胺只在這個骨架上加了一個氟原子，但在實驗室測試中，它能完全活化迷幻藥作用的5-HT2A受體。
fact.zhHans: 色胺是血清素、褪黑激素、DMT与脱磷酸裸盖菇素共同的简单骨架。4-氟色胺只在这个骨架上加了一个氟原子，但在实验室测试中，它能完全活化迷幻药作用的5-HT2A受体。
